description: This is a Java source file that provides an implementation of the FileUploadService interface, handling file uploads and deletions to and from Amazon S3 storage using the AWS SDK.

classes.name: FileUploadServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of file upload and delete operations to AWS S3, using Spring annotations and Lombok for dependency injection.

methods.name: uploadFile
methods.description: Uploads a file to an Amazon S3 bucket and returns the public URL if successful.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file from the Amazon S3 bucket given its URL.
